_comment: Alert settings. Copy this file to configs/alerts.json and edit it there. alerts.json is
gitignored and never leaves this computer, because a webhook URL works like a password
(anyone holding it can post into your channel) and the email block holds a password.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. After editing, restart the server.
channels: name -> one place alerts go. The name is yours (it is what the Alerts page and
its 'Send a test alert' button show). Every channel takes:
type: 'webhook' (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Zapier/Make/n8n for WhatsApp, Telegram
or SMS) or 'email' (any SMTP mail server).
enabled: true or false. A disabled channel is kept but nothing is sent to it.
events: which alerts go here. Any of 'anomaly' (records disagree with the cameras:
possible no-show, played but not booked, played but not checked in, booked while
closed), 'camera_silent' (a camera sent no picture during a slot), 'worker_down' (the
recording program is not running during a slot), 'worker_error' (it reports an error),
'playground_no_picture' (a camera of a playground that is on gave no picture for
several checks in a row), 'playground_stalled' (a playground that is on has not been
checked for more than three times its interval), 'daily_summary' (yesterday in one
line, slots and playground sessions). Leave it out to receive every alert.
min_severity: 'info' (everything), 'warning' or 'serious' (only the most important).
Webhook channels also take:
url: the incoming-webhook address. For Discord, add /slack to the end of the address.
Email channels also take:
host / port: the mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com 587 or smtp.office365.com 587.
security: 'starttls' (port 587, the usual), 'ssl' (port 465) or 'none'.
username / password: the login. For Gmail and Outlook use an app password, not your
normal password (Google account > Security > App passwords).
from: the sender address (defaults to username). to: one address or a list.
camera_silent_minutes: how long a camera may send no picture during a slot before an
alert (default 10). Never raised in a slot's first minutes. Also the least time a
playground camera must have given no picture before 'playground_no_picture'.
playground_dark_checks: how many playground checks in a row a camera must give no picture
in before 'playground_no_picture' (default 3). Both this and camera_silent_minutes apply.
cooldown_hours: the same problem is not repeated on a channel within this many hours
(default 6). An anomaly and a daily summary are only ever sent once.
check_interval_minutes: how often the server checks (default 5).
anomaly_lookback_hours: only anomalies found in this many recent hours are sent
(default 48), so switching alerts on does not replay months of history.
quiet_hours: optional; nothing is sent between start and end (it may cross midnight).
Whatever is still a problem when they end is sent then. Delete the key to turn it off.
daily_summary: optional time of day (HH:MM) to send yesterday's summary. Delete the key
to turn it off.
